token.description: Bot token. Better kept in .env as DISCORD_TOKEN, which wins over this.

allowedUsers.description: User ids allowed to prompt (Developer Mode → right-click a user → Copy User ID). Env: DISCORD_ALLOWED_USERS

allowedRoles.description: Role ids allowed to prompt. Env: DISCORD_ALLOWED_ROLES

allowEveryone.description: Let everyone who can see a channel prompt (and run shell commands on this machine). Needed when no users or roles are set. Env: DISCORD_ALLOW_EVERYONE=1

channels.description: Channels where mentions and /pi start tasks; empty means all. Env: DISCORD_CHANNELS

guilds.description: Servers to register slash commands in right away; otherwise they are global and can take an hour. Env: DISCORD_GUILDS

maxAttachmentMB.description: Larger attachments are named to the model but not saved. Default 25. Env: DISCORD_MAX_ATTACHMENT_MB

discord.description: Discord: who may use the bot, and where

provider.description: A built-in pi-ai provider, like anthropic, openai or deepseek. Default: pi's defaultProvider. Env: PI_PROVIDER

id.description: Model id of that provider. Default: pi's defaultModel. Env: PI_MODEL

thinking.description: Thinking level. Default: pi's defaultThinkingLevel, else medium. Env: PI_THINKING

model.description: The model every task uses; credentials come from pi's auth.json or the provider's API key variable

dir.description: Root of the agent's files. Default ./workspace. Env: PI_WORKDIR

mode.description: per-thread: each task works in <dir>/<threadId>. shared: every task works in <dir>, like one repo checkout. Env: PI_WORKSPACE_MODE

instructions.description: Project instructions for every task. Default <dir>/AGENTS.md. Env: PI_INSTRUCTIONS

dataDir.description: SQLite database and files waiting to be posted. Default ./data. Env: PI_DATA_DIR

agentDir.description: pi's agent directory (settings, auth, AGENTS.md, mcp.json). Default ~/.pi/agent. Env: PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR

config.description: An mcpServers file. Default <agentDir>/mcp.json. Env: PI_MCP_CONFIG (none turns MCP off)

codemode.description: Offer the codemode tool. Default true. Env: PI_CODEMODE
